Name: Tobacco and Hemp
Author: BadMoonBeast
Description:
[i]Hey guys, I know other people have added their own versions of these crops, but I am a persnickety Beast so I did my own. It's meant to be simple, but useful and fun, with strong profits for midgame (since IRL these are both highly profitable crops).[/i]

[b]Includes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Two Crops (Tobacco and Hemp), with seeds purchasable from Sandy
[*]Consumable Artisan Goods with buffs (but beware, tobacco is slightly poisonous too)
[*]Ability to produce vanilla cloth from hemp
[*]Gift Tastes for those who canonically smoke and who you can deduce might use hemp or hemp oil
[*]Japanese localization by me (メモ参照)
[*]Chinese localization by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ShiJiesang/about-me]ShiJiesang[/url]﻿
[*]French localization by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/vin163/about-me]vin163[/url]﻿
[/list]
[b]If you're interested in alternate seed sprites, they're available in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21305]Standardized Seed Sprites[/url]!

Issues:
[/b][i]Please let me know if you find any!


[/i]日本語翻訳メモ:
日本人じゃないから翻訳は大体自分の練習のためだけど、もうやったから入れちゃった。何か間違いがあったらぜひコメントで知らせてくださいね

[b]Please note[/b] that you will require [b]both[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order for this mod to work.
